title: GODMAN-LAUNCH — godman-launch-day.sh: operator playbook for April 14 npm publish
description: Create scripts/godman-launch-day.sh — a single shell script the operator runs on April 14 to: (1) verify npm login, (2) run smoke tests for all 7 protocols, (3) npm publish each protocol in order (pact, lax, score, signal, soul, amf, drs), (4) print success/fail per protocol + total published count. Exit non-zero if any publish fails.

tasks.title: Create scripts/godman-launch-day.sh
tasks.description: Shell script: check npm whoami, run npm test in each of 7 protocol dirs, then npm publish --access public. Color-coded output (green=ok, red=fail). Final summary line. Make executable (chmod +x). Also add to /godman command output: 'Run: bash scripts/godman-launch-day.sh on April 14'.
